meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 当用户要求回忆过去对话时，Claude 会在 cmem.ai 记忆库中先宽泛搜索再精确检索，最后用通俗语言总结相关记忆并回答；若报错或无结果，会运行诊断检查。
howto.when: 当你说“搜索记忆”、“你记得…吗”、“查一下 claude-mem”等，或想回顾某个旧项目/任务的相关记录时触发。

say.text: 搜索记忆：我们上次关于支付模块的讨论结论是什么？
say.note: 触发记忆搜索，并得到过去会话的概括回答。

say.text: 你对项目 Phoenix 的安全审计还记得哪些细节？
say.note: 按项目名检索过去提及该项目的观察记录。

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem，有没有关于数据库迁移的旧记录？
say.note: 直接使用 mem search 入口查找指定关键词。

howto.what_en: Claude searches the user's cmem.ai memory when asked about past sessions, doing broad keyword scans first then a narrower search, and replies in plain language instead of raw output. On error or no results it runs a status check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'search memory', 'what do you remember about X', 'check claude-mem', or wants prior-session context about a project/task.

say_en.text: Search my memory: what did we conclude about the payment module last time?
say_en.note: Performs a memory search and returns a summarized answer.

say_en.text: What do you remember about the Phoenix project security audit?
say_en.note: Looks up observations mentioning that project.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem for any old notes on database migration.
say_en.note: Searches memory for that specific keyword topic.
